_note: Single source of truth for Line of Command V1 balance numbers. spec.md quotes these values; if they disagree, this file wins and spec.md is the bug.
status: D11 DECIDED 2026-11-22 (captain): one-time Steam purchase, no subscription, DLC later under never_sold. D4 and D10 DECIDED the same day.

daily_limits._mirrors: breeds_per_day = breeding.limits.breeds_per_day_account; training clicks = skills.training; QA E6 fails if they differ

unlimited_no_progress_modes.note: No XP, Wisdom, skill/attribute growth, rank progress, trait/hidden reveals or breeding-eligibility count. A scenario replay is any scenario play that is not a taken scenario assignment (scenarios.json rules.daily, campaign.json).

base_game_includes: Replay controls: play/pause, 4x speed, scrubbing, per-tick stat overlay
Default uniforms, banners and portrait frames
dlc_allowed: Cosmetics (uniforms, flags, house crests, narrator voices, replay themes)
Replay studio (slow motion, GIF/MP4 export, share links)
never_sold: extra daily ranked battles, breeds or training clicks (timer skips)
buyer-only formations, units or stances (new ones ship free to all, unlocked through play)
loot boxes or random paid rolls
purchase_effects_on_numbers: none: no purchasable item may change any value in attributes, skills, traits, ranks, units, formations, terrain, stances, messenger, breeding, battle or daily_limits (QA E5)
currency: USD via Steam (one-time purchase and DLC); no in-game currency in V1
